name: Haruko Tsubaki
role: Night sister, Ward Four, the General Hospital
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from her full cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json (the General Hospital haunt, D050/D051/D052) -- nothing here is invented, all of it (the crossword, the postcard drawer, the bed-number-to-'dear' progression, the soldier's card line) is already written into her `brief` there (voice, doors, willDiscuss, holdInReserve, coercible, questions). This file exists so the Character Card / Actor / token pipeline (module/blank-inheritance/scripts/foundry/sync.mjs, scene-build.mjs) has a real npc to point at -- the haunts system was authored with full regulars baked directly into scene `cast[]` entries, and none of them were ever split out into their own data/npcs/ file. `canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json`'s cast entry for her needs its own `npcRef: "tsubaki"` added (then `node tools/story/story.mjs build` to sync data/) before the automatic pipeline can place a hidden reference token for her in that scene.

Approved by Ingram as written, no twist, no ancestry change (2026-09-29) -- kept human/unspecified ancestry on purpose.

Her real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file itself: "Proposed: level 2, a senior nurse, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists." Not carried into this file's `statblock` field for that reason -- she's statblock-less here, same as every other purely-social NPC.
status: established and voiced (the General Hospital haunt is built and playable) -- first haunt regular formalized into a real npc file

facts.text: Her bottom desk drawer is full of postcards from patients who went home, and she keeps every one.

revealTrigger.narrative: Being kind to her, or asking what she's smiling at.

facts.text: The soldier in the next bed has a card that says he fell. She didn't write it, and she knows it isn't true -- but she keeps her own counsel about what actually happened to him.

revealTrigger.dc: her Will DC, friendly attitude or better
